paragraphs: Rabbi Yehoshua ben Kefusai, Rabbi Akiva’s son-in-law: Shabbat 147a; he spoke to Rabbi there. In Bekhorot 35b: Ben Kefisai; there, 39a: Ben Kefutzai; Demai 3:4: Kabsui. In the Jerusalem Talmud, Pesachim, the chapter Ellu Devarim, halakhah 1: ‘All my days I used to flee from authority. Now that I have entered it, anyone who would remove me, I come down upon him with a kettle of boiling water.’ Rabbi Yose bar Bun said: ‘Heaven forbid that he desired it! Rather, he would say: Who can tell me that another will sanctify the name of Heaven as I do?’ See Rabbi Yehoshua ben Perachyah, who also said this according to Rashi’s second explanation in Menachot 109b, end; Yehudah ben Tabbai said it too. Bekhorot 35b: ‘For it was taught: Rabbi Yehoshua ben Kefusai says,’ and so forth; ‘Rabban Shimon ben Gamliel says,’ and so forth; ‘Rabbi Yose says,’ and so forth. From this it appears that he was old and lived a long time, since he is placed before Rabban Shimon ben Gamliel and spoke with Rabbi. In the Tosefta at the end of Maaserot: Ben Kabusyo; and in Bekhorot, chapter 3: ‘Kefusai says,’ and so forth, ‘Rabbi Chanina ben Antigonos says.’ See Rabban Shimon ben Gamliel the Elder.
